intent: Right-aligned user message in the Agent chat thread: a text bubble with an optional context chip above it and a 24px avatar to its right.

slots.avatar: Custom avatar node (ReactNode); defaults to a neutral CircleUserRound glyph on a c-bg-secondary circle.

chip: element (blue canvas-selection chip: layer-list icon + label)

bubble.note: rounded-[16px], max-w-[192px], px-[12px] py-[9px], text-[13px]/leading-[20px], font-[450], tracking-[-0.032px], and column gap-[8px] are hardcoded, not tokens.

avatar.note: size-[24px] circle; default CircleUserRound glyph size 15 / strokeWidth 1.5 hardcoded.

ElementChip.note: h-[20px], max-w-[157px], gap-[2px], pl-[2px] pr-[5px], icon size 13 (in a 16px box), text-[12px]/leading-[16px], font-[450] hardcoded.

GitHubChip.note: h-[24px], gap-[4px], px-[5px] py-[2px], icon size 14, text-[11px]/leading-[16px], font-[450], tracking-[0.055px] hardcoded.

a11y.role: none — presentational <div>; not focusable or interactive. The message text is the accessible content.
a11y.icons: the avatar glyph and both chip icons are decorative lucide SVGs with no alt or aria-label.
a11y.host: the enclosing chat log/thread supplies message-turn and author semantics; UserBubble renders only the visual bubble.

code.example: <UserBubble text="Turn this into a video" chip={{ type: 'element', label: 'Hero Section', kind: 'frame' }} />
